rfis: Site control: provide executed lease/option agreements for APN 002-180-019-000 and all adjacent parcels (term, escalation, purchase options, recorded memoranda), a current preliminary title report, ALTA survey, and confirmed gross/net acreage — site_acres is null and 100 MW requires ~500-700 ac at the 5-7 ac/MW benchmark.

Zoning/land use: provide the parcel's Kings County zoning and General Plan designations, Williamson Act contract number and status (including any non-renewal or cancellation filings), DOC FMMP Important Farmland classification, and any prior SB 618 solar-use easement analysis.

Permitting: provide all permit applications filed or planned (CUP/site plan review, grading, building), the CEQA strategy (EIR vs. MND) or CEC AB 205 Opt-In Certification intent, and a permitting milestone schedule.

Interconnection: provide the CAISO interconnection request number, queue position and cluster, study phase and results (Phase I/II), deliverability election (FCDS vs. Energy-Only), point of interconnection and voltage, network upgrade cost estimates, and any executed Interconnection Agreement.

Offtake: provide all executed or draft PPAs/tolling agreements/LOIs with counterparties, tenor, price, and contracted MW/MWh vs. nameplate, plus status of negotiations — bankability norm is >=80% of P50 energy contracted at financial close.

CAPEX/financials: provide a detailed CAPEX budget in $/Wac with EPC quotes or term sheets, and the pro forma model including revenue, ITC/PTC and adder assumptions (domestic content, energy community), debt sizing, and sources & uses.

Tax credits: provide beginning-of-construction documentation under OBBBA/Notice 2025-42 (physical work of a significant nature — the 5% safe harbor is unavailable for >1.5 MW solar), the continuity plan, FEOC/material-assistance compliance analysis for IRC 45Y/48E eligibility, and the placed-in-service target relative to the July 4, 2026 start-of-construction deadline.

Equipment/procurement: provide module, tracker, inverter, and BESS supply agreements or quotes (pricing, delivery schedules, domestic content specs); GSU/main power transformer orders with OEM, production slot confirmation, and quoted lead time (market norm 128-144 weeks); and BESS capacity (MWh/duration) with UL 9540/9540A certification.
Schedule: provide the integrated milestone schedule (NTP, major equipment delivery, energization, COD) reconciled to permitting, interconnection, and procurement critical paths.

Resource/engineering: provide the solar resource assessment and P50/P90 energy yield report, BESS dispatch and augmentation plan, preliminary layout with setbacks and gen-tie route, geotechnical report, hydrology/drainage study, and Phase I ESA.

Environmental: provide biological survey results (San Joaquin kit fox, blunt-nosed leopard lizard, Swainson's hawk, burrowing owl, Tipton/giant kangaroo rat), an aquatic resources delineation (Tulare Lake bed/ephemeral drainages), cultural resources survey, and tribal outreach records.
Community/government relations: provide the community engagement plan, documentation of any opposition or support, and any agreements with Kings County (e.g., development agreement).
Water: provide the construction and operational water supply plan (dust control) given SGMA critically overdrafted status of the Tulare Lake and Kings groundwater subbasins.
Corporate: provide entity structure, development track record, capitalization, and any existing financing commitments.

Data room: re-run fact extraction on the source data room and deliver the extracted facts set — the current record contains zero extracted facts, making cross-examination and all core contradiction checks unperformable.

agency_actions.agency: Kings County Community Development Agency (Planning Division)
agency_actions.action: Submit a written zoning verification request for APN 002-180-019-000 covering zoning/General Plan designation, whether utility-scale solar+BESS is a permitted or conditionally permitted use, and CUP/site plan review requirements.
agency_actions.why: Unresolved kill criterion: CA county precedent (e.g., Solano) shows outright prohibition of commercial solar/BESS on ag-zoned land; if prohibited, the local permit path dies and the CEC AB 205 opt-in route becomes mandatory.
agency_actions.deadline: Submit within 5 business days; written verification typically returned in 2-4 weeks

agency_actions.agency: Kings County Agricultural Commissioner and California Department of Conservation, Division of Land Resource Protection
agency_actions.action: Obtain Williamson Act contract status and map for the parcel plus FMMP Important Farmland classification; if under contract, evaluate cancellation (Gov. Code sec. 51282, 12.5% of FMV fee) versus an SB 618 solar-use easement.
agency_actions.why: Solar is an incompatible use on Williamson Act contracted land; cancellation costs 12.5-25% of FMV and materially affect CAPEX and schedule.
agency_actions.deadline: Records request within 5 business days; DOC response ~30 days

agency_actions.action: Request a pre-application meeting on AB 205 Opt-In Certification (Pub. Resources Code sec. 25545; eligible for solar >=50 MW) as the fallback permitting route if local zoning fails.
agency_actions.why: CEC certification preempts local permitting and carries a 270-day decision target, providing a viable path if Kings County zoning prohibits the project.
agency_actions.deadline: Schedule pre-application meeting within 30 days of the zoning determination

agency_actions.action: Confirm the project's queue position, cluster, study phase, deliverability election (FCDS vs. Energy-Only), and network upgrade cost exposure; if no position exists, assess the next cluster application window.
agency_actions.why: CAISO interconnection-request-to-COD is now ~5 years and only ~20% of queued projects reach COD; network upgrade cost shock is the #1 dropout driver.
agency_actions.deadline: Confirm within 10 business days via developer queue data and CAISO account records

agency_actions.agency: California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW), Central Region (Region 4)
agency_actions.action: Initiate early consultation on CESA-listed species (San Joaquin kit fox, blunt-nosed leopard lizard, Swainson's hawk), protocol survey requirements, and likelihood of a 2081 incidental take permit; flag Lake/Streambed Alteration Agreement (Fish & Game Code sec. 1602) needs.
agency_actions.why: Blunt-nosed leopard lizard is fully protected under California law — presence can be fatal to the site layout; survey windows are seasonal and drive the schedule.
agency_actions.deadline: Consultation request within 15 business days; protocol surveys aligned to spring/summer windows

agency_actions.agency: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS), Sacramento Fish and Wildlife Office
agency_actions.action: Request a species list (IPaC) and technical assistance on federal ESA exposure (San Joaquin kit fox, giant kangaroo rat) and whether Section 7 consultation or a Section 10 HCP is required.
agency_actions.why: Federal take authorization may be required independent of state permits and can add 12+ months if an HCP is needed.
agency_actions.deadline: IPaC list within 10 business days; scoping response within 60 days

agency_actions.agency: Central Valley Regional Water Quality Control Board (Region 5, Fresno office) and State Water Resources Control Board
agency_actions.action: Confirm Construction General Permit (Order 2022-0057-DWQ) enrollment path via SMARTS, SWPPP requirements, and whether Waste Discharge Requirements or a 401 certification are triggered by any waters on site.
agency_actions.why: NPDES coverage is a precondition to ground disturbance; Tulare Lake bed hydrology may create jurisdictional waters issues.
agency_actions.deadline: Determination within 30 days; SMARTS enrollment before any grading

agency_actions.agency: San Joaquin Valley Air Pollution Control District (SJVAPCD)
agency_actions.action: Confirm Regulation VIII fugitive dust control plan requirements, Rule 9510 Indirect Source Review applicability, and any stationary source permits (e.g., backup generators).
agency_actions.why: Kings County is in a severe nonattainment area; dust plan approval is a grading precondition and ISR fees affect CAPEX.

agency_actions.agency: Native American Heritage Commission (NAHC) and California SHPO
agency_actions.action: Request a Sacred Lands File search and tribal contact list; initiate AB 52 tribal consultation through the CEQA lead agency and scope Section 106 consultation if a federal nexus exists.
agency_actions.why: AB 52 consultation is a CEQA legal prerequisite; unaddressed tribal cultural resources are a leading cause of EIR delay and litigation.
agency_actions.deadline: NAHC request within 10 business days; consultation opened with CEQA Notice of Preparation

agency_actions.agency: Kings County Airport Land Use Commission and DoD Military Aviation and Installation Assurance Siting Clearinghouse
agency_actions.action: Determine whether the parcel lies within the NAS Lemoore Airport Influence Area; if so, obtain an ALUC compatibility determination and file for DoD Siting Clearinghouse review with a glint/glare analysis (ForgeSolar).
agency_actions.why: NAS Lemoore is the Navy's largest master jet base and is located in Kings County; glare and radar impacts can trigger DoD objection and permit denial.
agency_actions.deadline: AIA screening within 15 business days; Clearinghouse review 60-90 days if required

agency_actions.agency: Kings County Fire Department / Fire Marshal
agency_actions.action: Engage on BESS fire safety requirements: California Fire Code energy systems provisions, NFPA 855 compliance, UL 9540A test data review, emergency response plan, and site access/water supply for fire suppression.
agency_actions.why: BESS fire safety approval is a building permit precondition and a lender/insurer requirement; early fire marshal alignment avoids redesign.

agency_actions.agency: Kings Groundwater Sustainability Agencies (Tulare Lake and Kings subbasins) and applicable irrigation/water district
agency_actions.action: Confirm construction water supply availability and any pumping restrictions under SGMA, including the Tulare Lake subbasin probationary status before the State Water Board.
agency_actions.why: Both subbasins are critically overdrafted; dust control for a 500-700 ac site requires a firm water source that SGMA restrictions may constrain.

agency_actions.agency: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Sacramento District
agency_actions.action: Obtain an approved jurisdictional determination if the aquatic resources delineation identifies potentially jurisdictional waters (Tulare Lake bed, ephemeral drainages); assess Section 404 permit needs.
agency_actions.why: Unanticipated jurisdictional waters can force layout redesign and add 6-12 months of federal permitting.
agency_actions.deadline: AJD request within 60 days of delineation completion

agency_actions.action: Obtain a tax opinion or memo confirming IRC 45Y/48E eligibility under OBBBA and Notice 2025-42: physical-work beginning-of-construction evidence, continuity, FEOC material-assistance compliance, and placed-in-service timing.
agency_actions.why: Unresolved kill criterion: without documented beginning of construction by July 4, 2026, the 30% ITC/PTC may be forfeited — a ~30% swing in project economics.
agency_actions.deadline: Tax memo before investment committee; construction-start evidence preserved contemporaneously

Transformer OEM (e.g., Hitachi Energy, Siemens Energy, GE Vernova, Prolec GE, Hyundai): verify any claimed GSU/main power transformer order, production slot, and quoted lead time against the 128-144 week market norm; if no order exists, obtain current budgetary quotes and slot availability.
Module supplier: verify supply agreement or quote, pricing, delivery schedule, and domestic content qualification (for the 10% ITC adder) directly with the manufacturer.
BESS integrator (e.g., Tesla, Fluence, Sungrow, CATL): verify quoted lead times, pricing, and UL 9540/9540A certification status for the specified system.
Title company: obtain an independent preliminary title report and confirm ownership, encumbrances, mineral rights, and any recorded easements or Williamson Act notices on APN 002-180-019-000.
Kings County Assessor/Recorder: verify parcel acreage, ownership of record, and any recorded lease memoranda supporting claimed site control.
Landowner(s): confirm directly that lease/option agreements are executed, current, and cover the full buildable area claimed.
Independent engineer: validate the P50/P90 energy yield, BESS dispatch assumptions, and CAPEX against LBNL/NREL benchmarks ($1.43-1.56/Wac installed) once developer data is produced.
EPC contractor: verify any quoted EPC price and schedule directly, including validity period and escalation terms.
Tax counsel (independent): verify the beginning-of-construction position under Notice 2025-42 and FEOC compliance rather than relying on developer tax representations.
conditions_precedent: Data room completeness: fact extraction re-run on the source data room with a complete extracted facts set delivered; no IC vote on an empty record.
Site control: executed lease/option agreements covering >=500-700 contiguous buildable acres (5-7 ac/MW for 100 MW) with a clean preliminary title report and title insurance commitment.

Zoning resolution: written Kings County zoning verification confirming utility-scale solar+BESS is permitted or conditionally permitted, OR CEC acceptance of an AB 205 Opt-In Certification application; Williamson Act status resolved via cancellation, non-renewal, SB 618 solar-use easement, or confirmation the parcel is uncontracted.

Tax credit eligibility: documented beginning of construction satisfying Notice 2025-42 (physical work test; no 5% safe harbor) before July 4, 2026, with continuity plan and FEOC/material-assistance compliance memo from independent tax counsel.

Interconnection: executed CAISO Interconnection Agreement, or at minimum completed Phase II cluster study with network upgrade costs within an approved cap and a deliverability election consistent with the offtake.
Offtake: executed PPA(s)/tolling agreement(s) covering >=80% of P50 energy with creditworthy counterparties at financial close.
CAPEX validation: EPC-level CAPEX within +/-10% of the $1.43-1.56/Wac LBNL/NREL benchmark, supported by firm quotes.

Procurement critical path: firm GSU/main power transformer supply agreement with delivery aligned to the energization date (lead time tested against the 128-144 week norm), plus executed module and BESS supply agreements with delivery schedules consistent with COD.

Environmental clearance: completed protocol biological surveys with no unmitigable fully protected species (blunt-nosed leopard lizard) conflict; CEQA path (EIR/MND or CEC certification) determined with a realistic schedule; AB 52 tribal consultation initiated.
BESS fire safety: Kings County Fire Marshal concurrence on the NFPA 855/UL 9540A-based fire safety and emergency response plan.
Water supply: firm construction water source confirmed given SGMA critically overdrafted status of the Tulare Lake/Kings subbasins.
Schedule realism: integrated milestone schedule reconciled to permitting, interconnection (~5-year CAISO norm), and transformer lead times, with COD no earlier than these constraints allow.
Military/aviation clearance: NAS Lemoore AIA screening completed and, if applicable, DoD Siting Clearinghouse no-objection and ALUC compatibility determination obtained.
Financial model: pro forma validated with contracted revenue, confirmed ITC/PTC treatment, and downside cases for Energy-Only deliverability and network upgrade cost overruns.
